subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should final-answer candidate lifecycle entries land as this bounded Activity surface after the current-main UI port, or should they be folded into the broader native Codex progress work?
rationale: The code issue is repairable, but the permanent product surface for native Codex progress is broader than this PR and is already tracked by an open related issue.

options.title: Port and land the bounded slice
options.body: Rebase the PR onto current main, port the Activity wiring to the current UI modules, refresh proof, and land it as the answer-candidate slice of native Codex progress.

options.title: Fold into the broader progress work
options.body: Keep this PR as reference material and implement answer-candidate entries inside the canonical native Codex progress solution instead.

options.title: Pause or close this direction
options.body: Do not merge the Activity surface unless maintainers decide answer-candidate lifecycle state should be user-visible.

recommendation.title: Port and land the bounded slice
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR onto current main, port the Activity wiring to the current UI modules, refresh proof, and land it as the answer-candidate slice of native Codex progress.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the clearest UI stream history in the touched surface and is already connected to the Control UI product boundary.
